page.overview:
Who is Prototype Ai-B?

Prototype Ai-B is a character appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS anime.

Prototype Ai-B uses a "Tentacluster" Deck, which unlike Prototype Ai-A , focuses on effect damage.
